messages:
Raja - Sales: Quick handoff - Cedar Health signed for Dedicated tier (initial commit: 3x A10 GPUs). SSO & HIPAA addendum signed. Kickoff requested 2024-04-02. Key contacts: janet@cedar.com (tech), mike.partner@cedar.com (billing). Renewal note: 12-mo with option to expand; procurement may push for usage proof before full spend. :tada:

Avery - CS: Thanks Raja — I’ll own onboarding. Need expected peak RPS, median/peak prompt length, and Okta metadata. Also confirm preferred region and whether BYOK is required.

Raja - Sales: Peak ~100 req/s, median prompt ~800 tokens, occasional 2048 sequences. Region: us-west-2. Okta metadata DM'ed to Avery. BYOK: customer asks for BYOK via AWS KMS (will confirm key ARN).

Mina (SE): I'll take infra sizing. For 100 req/s and 800-token median, recommend start with 3x A10, autoscale to 5 for bursts. Quick provisioning snippet and firewall hint below:
```yaml
dedicated_pool:
  gpus: 3
  instance_type: a10xlarge
  region: us-west-2
network:
  allowed_ips:
    - 13.32.0.0/16
ssm: enabled
```
Also: enable KV/prefix caching and 90-day logs. @Avery we should pin model variant to an 8-bit quantized for cost during pilot.

Avery - CS: Owners and next steps: Avery - onboarding lead; Mina - infra & provisioning; Jon - support/runbook; Priya - renewals. Action items:
1) Mina to confirm final GPU count and autoscale policy by 2024-03-25.
2) Mina + Jon to draft incident runbook & escalation contacts by 2024-03-29.
3) Avery to schedule kickoff w/ Cedar for 2024-04-02 (invite sent).
4) Sales to provide Okta test user + SAML metadata by EOD.

Jon - Support: I'll prepare the incident runbook: on-call rotations, escalation matrix, known failure modes (OOM, KV cache miss storm), and postmortem owners. Will link draft here when ready. Note: set log retention 90 days for Private.

Raja - Sales: Confirmed billing contact: mike.partner@cedar.com. Also flagged potential renewal risk: procurement may request switch to pay-as-you-go after pilot — Priya pls monitor and prep negotiating levers (usage thresholds, committed discount).

Priya - CS Manager: I’ll own renewal cadence. Recommend weekly health checks starting week 2 post-kickoff. Key metrics to track: DAU/MAU adoption, token consumption growth week-over-week, P95 latency, error rates, support tickets opened. If adoption lags, we prepare a usage case pack for procurement.

Avery - CS: Kickoff confirmed 2024-04-02 16:00 PT — attendees: Janice (Cedar), Mike (Cedar), internal: Mina, Jon, Priya. Goal: production pilot by 2024-04-16. I’ll create a milestone tracker and post updates in #customer-success. :rocket:

eng-oncall-bot: New ticket created: INC-3245 assigned to Jon for runbook prep (https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-3245).

Mina (SE): Quick Q — do we need HSM (HSM/KMS) integration now or can that be deferred post-pilot? Cedar requested BYOK. @Avery pls confirm ASAP so we don't block provisioning.

Avery - CS: BYOK required. Opening JIRA RED-879 for KMS onboarding and assigning to Mina + infra-sec.

Raja - Sales: Thanks team — will monitor procurement conversations and surface any blocker.

Avery - CS: Closing note: I'll post a weekly status summary after kickoff. If anyone needs access to the customer workspace or artifacts, ping me. End of thread.
